[[Linen Scrap]]s are tier four [[basic crafting material|basic]] [[crafting material]]s. Two scraps can be [[refinement|refined]] into a [[Bolt of Linen]] by [[Armorsmith]]s, [[Leatherworker]]s, [[Scribe]]s and [[Tailor]]s. They can be salvaged from level 44-63 [[light armor]].

{{gathered from}}
